conventions.target: OBSERVED arbitration dollars, never surplus_backtest_real, whose realized side is computed from the same constant being fitted
conventions.metric: MAE of the DISCOUNTED arbitration-window salary total per player
conventions.basis: prior_season, matching the shipped clemens_2026 set
conventions.floor: paired bootstrap clustered on PLAYER, refitting the ladder on every draw, one-sided MDE95

loss_ledger.claim: the fitted arbitration ladder should replace the shipped constant
loss_ledger.statement: The fitted ladder is a LEVEL correction, not a shape correction. A single global scalar applied to the shipped clemens_2026 ladder captures 100.0% of the fitted ladder's improvement, against a pre-registered 75% rule. It ships, if it ships, as one parameter. The three- and four-number ladders are NOT supported by this measurement, and value_framework_config.yaml is UNCHANGED.
